description: This file defines the nl80211_client_impl class, which implements the nl80211_client interface for interacting with WiFi drivers via NL80211 sockets. It includes method declarations for retrieving interface, radio, station, and survey information, as well as setting power limits, managing keys, and controlling scans.

classes.name: nl80211_client_impl
classes.description: Implementation of the nl80211_client interface for WiFi driver communication using NL80211 sockets.

methods.name: get_interfaces
methods.description: Retrieves a list of existing wireless VAP interface names.

methods.name: get_interface_info
methods.description: Retrieves information about a specific network interface, including MAC address and SSID.

methods.name: get_radio_info
methods.description: Retrieves radio capabilities and supported channels for a given interface.

methods.name: get_sta_info
methods.description: Retrieves metrics related to a station connected to a virtual AP.

methods.name: get_survey_info
methods.description: Retrieves survey data such as channel occupation and noise levels.

methods.name: set_tx_power_limit
methods.description: Sets the transmission power limit for a radio interface.

methods.name: get_tx_power_dbm
methods.description: Gets the current transmission power in dBm for a radio interface.

methods.name: channel_scan_abort
methods.description: Aborts an ongoing channel scan on a specified interface.

methods.name: add_key
methods.description: Adds a security key for a station.

methods.name: add_station
methods.description: Manually adds a station with associated parameters.

methods.name: get_key
methods.description: Retrieves key information for a station.

methods.name: send_delba
methods.description: Sends a DELBA frame to a station to delete a block acknowledgment agreement.
